places.name: Statue of Unity (Kevadia)
places.ai_summary: The world's tallest statue, dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, located near the Narmada River.

opening_hours.notes: Light and sound show in the evening.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to avoid queues.
places.address: Statue of Unity, Kevadia, Gujarat, India

places.name: Somnath Temple
places.ai_summary: A historic Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for its architectural beauty and spiritual significance.

opening_hours.notes: Aarti timings may vary.

places.place_tip: Attend the evening aarti for a spiritual experience.

places.name: Dwarkadhish Temple (Dwarka)
places.ai_summary: A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Krishna, located in the ancient city of Dwarka.

opening_hours.notes: Aarti timings may vary.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby Gomti Ghat and other temples.

places.name: Gir National Park (Asiatic Lions)
places.ai_summary: A renowned wildlife sanctuary in Gujarat, famous for its population of Asiatic lions.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guide.

places.place_tip: Visit the Devaliya Safari Park for a higher chance of lion sightings.

places.name: Rann of Kutch (White Desert)
places.ai_summary: A vast salt desert in Gujarat, known for its stunning white landscape and the Rann Utsav festival.

opening_hours.notes: Visit during the Rann Utsav for a cultural experience.

places.place_tip: Carry water and sun protection; facilities are limited.

places.name: Sabarmati Ashram (Ahmedabad)
places.ai_summary: The former home of Mahatma Gandhi, now a museum and ashram dedicated to his life and work.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Thursdays.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum and take a walk by the river.

places.name: Adalaj Stepwell
places.ai_summary: An intricately carved stepwell, also known as Adalaj Vav, built in the 15th century.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby Sun Temple.

places.name: Sun Temple (Modhera)
places.ai_summary: A 11th-century temple dedicated to the Sun God, known for its intricate carvings and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Visit during the sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the stepwell and the ruins of the old temple complex.

places.name: Laxmi Vilas Palace (Vadodara)
places.ai_summary: The grand residence of the Maratha royal family, known for its impressive architecture and museum.

opening_hours.notes: Audio guides available for a better experience.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum and the beautiful gardens.
places.address: Laxmi Vilas Palace, Vadodara, Gujarat, India

places.name: Akshardham Temple (Gandhinagar)
places.ai_summary: A modern Hindu temple known for its stunning architecture, intricate carvings, and spiritual significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Attend the evening light and sound show.

places.name: Great Rann Utsav Festival Site
places.ai_summary: The venue for the Rann Utsav, a cultural festival showcasing the rich heritage of Gujarat.

opening_hours.notes: Check festival dates for specific events.

places.place_tip: Experience the local culture and cuisine at the festival.

places.name: Marine National Park (Jamnagar)
places.ai_summary: India's first marine national park, known for its rich biodiversity and coral reefs.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored through a guided boat tour.

places.place_tip: Book a glass-bottom boat ride for a unique experience.
places.address: Marine National Park, Jamnagar, Gujarat, India

places.name: Saputara Hill Station
places.ai_summary: The only hill station in Gujarat, known for its cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the monsoon or winter.

places.place_tip: Visit the Saputara Lake and take a cable car ride.

places.name: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, featuring ancient temples, palaces, and the famous Pavagadh Fort.

opening_hours.notes: Hire a guide to explore the area effectively.

places.place_tip: Visit the Jain temples and the Pavagadh Fort for stunning views.

places.name: Somnath Beach
places.ai_summary: A serene beach located near the Somnath Temple, ideal for relaxation and spiritual solace.

opening_hours.notes: Cleanliness is maintained by the local authorities.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Somnath Temple.

places.name: Dholavira (Indus Valley Site)
places.ai_summary: An archaeological site of an ancient city of the Indus Valley Civilization, known for its advanced urban planning.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available and recommended.

places.place_tip: Visit the archaeological museum on-site for detailed insights.

places.name: Mandvi Beach
places.ai_summary: A tranquil beach known for its white sands, clear waters, and the nearby Vijay Vilas Palace.

opening_hours.notes: Water sports are available at an additional cost.

places.place_tip: Visit the Vijay Vilas Palace and take a camel ride on the beach.

places.name: Kankaria Lake (Ahmedabad)
places.ai_summary: A circular lake with a beautiful garden, zoo, and amusement park located in Ahmedabad.

opening_hours.notes: Boating and other activities available at an extra cost.

places.place_tip: Visit the lakefront and enjoy a boat ride.

places.name: Jama Masjid (Ahmedabad)
places.ai_summary: A magnificent mosque built in the 15th century, known for its stunning architecture and peaceful ambiance.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby markets for a complete experience.

places.name: Junagadh Uparkot Fort
places.ai_summary: A historic fort with impressive architecture and panoramic views, located in Junagadh.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for exploring the fort.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the ancient Buddhist caves nearby.
